body:
### Features
- **General:** Report OTLP export status [#9517](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9517)
- **LLM Observability:** Add experiments dataset operations [#9458](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9458)
- **LLM Observability:** Emit experiment traces [#9479](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9479)
- **Test Optimization:** Add ci.pipeline.display_name tag for Buildkite [#9541](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9541)
- **Test Optimization:** Add WebdriverIO optimizations [#9556](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9556)
- **Test Optimization:** Support Vitest Browser Mode [#9535](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9535)
- **Test Optimization:** Support WebdriverIO with Mocha [#9520](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9520)

### Fixes
- **AppSec:** Fix express ssrf flaky test [#9564](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9564)
- **Feature Flags:** Disable the provider for unsupported sources [#9482](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9482)
- **General:** Wait for asyncEnd on promise settlement [#9538](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9538)
- **General:** Wrap Node builtins once across CommonJS and ESM [#9576](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9576)
- **google-cloud-pubsub:** Fix DSM context propagation for google-cloud-pubsub [#7582](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/7582)
- **logs:** Properly split name and version for scoped names [#9508](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9508)
- **rhea:** DSM context leak between concurrent consumers [#7581](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/7581)
- **Test Optimization:** Detect swapped directories when inode numbers exceed 2^53 [#9580](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9580)
- **Test Optimization:** Hide WebdriverIO worker messages [#9561](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9561)
- **Test Optimization:** Keep playwright summary counts on one line [#9587](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9587)
- **Test Optimization:** Wait for WebDriverIO worker payloads [#9565](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9565)

### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking)
- **Dependencies:** Bump @hono/node-server [#9603](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9603)
- **Dependencies:** Bump @smithy/smithy-client [#9550](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9550)
- **Dependencies:** Bump next [#9572](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9572)
- **Dependencies:** Bump the vendor-minor-and-patch-dependencies group across 1 directory with 3 updates [#9571](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9571)
- **eslint:** Update eslint-plugin-unicorn to 72 [#9503](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9503)
- **Feature Flags:** Update node server provider to 2.0.2 [#9480](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9480)
- **General:** Drop the removed agent.close options argument [#9583](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9583)
- **General:** Pin docker/login-action to a commit SHA [#9582](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9582)
- **licenses:** Read dependencies directly from lockfiles [#9540](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9540)
- **lint:** Clear shellcheck and regexp findings ahead of enabling the rules [#9586](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9586)
- **scripts:** Speed up verify-exercised-tests and close detection gaps [#9542](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9542)
- **Test Optimization:** Gather known-tests payloads until the child exits [#9590](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9590)
- **Test Optimization:** Gather multiproject payloads until the child exits [#9577](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9577)
- **Test Optimization:** Make preload path assertion portable [#9581](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9581)
- **Test Optimization:** Prevent test swallowing errors [#9567](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9567)
- **Test Optimization:** Set the API key on the config the exporter reads [#9579](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9579)
- **tsconfig:** Drop deprecated alwaysStrict and baseUrl options [#9557](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9557)
